title: Schedule a Mac restart in a few minutes
summary: Set your Mac to automatically restart after a specific delay, such as 5 minutes. This allows you to finish tasks before the reboot.

steps.explain: This command schedules a system reboot to occur in 5 minutes. You can change '+5' to any number of minutes.

rollback.explain: To cancel a scheduled shutdown or restart, run the shutdown command with the -c flag.

warnings: Ensure you save all work before the scheduled time.
The system will reboot automatically at the specified time.
